youtube_title: Leg 'fell Asleep' On The Toilet? Here's What Happened | Body Fix #30 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #30. Phone on the toilet, stand up... and your leg TINGLES like it fell asleep?
B is right. A NERVE was pressed. Pressure scrambles its signals.
Cross-legged or one position too long squeezes the nerve. Move and it goes.
Fix: Stand, shake it, walk; don't sit in one position for hours.
Red flags: Numbness that stays, comes without pressure, weakness or face/arm numb? DOCTOR now.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Pins and needles
